disposition_reason: Table 3 prints mean ± SD concentrations of 30 elements in eight hypertonic, isotonic and hypotonic beverages bought in Greece.

study.design: Market survey of eight functional (sports and energy-type) beverages
study.method: Acid digestion of 25 mL with HNO3 and HCl, made up to 25 mL in 1% HNO3; ICP-OES
lod: not stated per element; calibration 0.001-0.5 mg/L for low-concentration elements
study.qa: Standard solution every ten analyses and 1% HNO3 blank; no CRM or recovery reported; three replicate analyses per sample
